description: This file defines an abstract actor class 'DittoRootActor' using Akka framework in Java. It implements supervision logic, actor startup, and HTTP route binding related to a Ditto service.

classes.name: DittoRootActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class serving as the root actor for a Ditto service, handling supervision, actor management, and HTTP routing.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the actor, including starting child actors and logging failures.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the supervisor strategy, configured as a one-for-one strategy with custom supervision logic.

methods.name: getSupervisionDecider
methods.description: Provides the partial function that determines how to handle different exception types during supervision.

methods.name: startChildActor
methods.description: Starts a new child actor with a given name and Props.

methods.name: restartChild
methods.description: Defines the directive to restart a child actor upon failure.

methods.name: bindHttpStatusRoute
methods.description: Binds an HTTP route for status checks and health monitoring using provided config and health actor.
